Kelp Forest

The seabed is abundant with kelp in many different shapes and sizes. Small fish are constantly shifting through the kelp fields looking to nibble on smaller plants or fish.

Kelp Forest is a location that can be found in the Syrenthia region.

Visibility

This location is only visible if the following requirement is met.

  • Requires [1] Diving gear equipped.

Keyword

The following keywords apply to this location.

Underwater

Faction

Kelp Forest is a member of the following factions:

Syrenthia

Activities

The following activities always available at this location.

Kelp foraging
Drift net hunting
Coral cutting

Emergency Activity

These Emergency Activities are only visible if you are missing key items for traveling, and are there to prevent softlocks.

Emergency swim escape

Routes
